usedFor: Pointagram gamifies team activity, and “Create Player” and “Add Points” keep scores up to date.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Lemon Squeezy, then “Create Player” in Pointagram
bestTemplate.why: A new order adds a person who can be scored, and the action creates them as a player.

watchOut: “Create or Find Player” searches first, so use it when you want to reuse an existing player.
